body:
# ASGARDEX v1.46.1 🚀

Fixes max ADA swaps, BSC sends with a zero base fee, fee-estimate swap memos, and max native RUNE deposits.

## What's Changed

### Update / Fixes

* Fix a bug causing the swapping of the entire ADA balance of the wallet. by @erikd in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1218
* fix(evm): set maxFeePerGas explicitly so BSC txs build with a zero base fee by @Eumaios1212 in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1219
* More property testing (and a fix) by @erikd in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1222
* Leave 0.02 RUNE on a max native deposit and bump xchainjs by @underthesun49 in https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/pull/1224

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/asgardex/asgardex-desktop/compare/v1.46.0...v1.46.1
